cases.purpose: Workspace .commandagent preset beats workspace .anvil
Workspace .anvil preset beats user ~/.commandagent
Preset fields merge per field across files
CLI flag beats preset field
Top-level footer=off is applied
First file containing a top-level key wins
Unknown top-level key (model) is rejected with file and line
cases.note: Old expectation: stdout contains the unknown-key message and a bare '1'. New (Issue #782): the diagnostic must name the config file path with its line (config.toml:1) and the key, and the value must not appear. The doctor exit is nonzero because startup config resolution fails, with or without a preset.

cases.purpose: Unknown top-level key in the workspace file fails startup and is not skipped for the lower file footer (Issue #782; was skipped with the lower footer applied)
cases.note: Old expectation: exit nonzero only because doctor reported other failures, stdout 'disabled by resolved footer configuration' (broken workspace file skipped, lower HOME footer applied) and no failed Configuration check. New: the unknown key is a startup error, so doctor reports a failed Configuration check naming the file, line and key, and the lower footer is never applied. Changed per the 2026-10-21 decision recorded in Issue #782.

cases.purpose: Unknown preset key is rejected naming preset.<name>.<key> and line
cases.note: Old expectation: stdout contains preset.p.bogus and a bare '3'. New (Issue #782): the diagnostic must name the config file with line 3 (config.toml:3); behaviour is unchanged, only the expectation is stricter.

cases.purpose: Invalid TOML syntax is reported without panic
cases.note: Old expectation: stdout contains 'invalid TOML syntax' and the message carried the parser's source excerpt. New (Issue #782): the diagnostic is file and line only (config.toml:1) with no source excerpt, so a malformed value cannot leak; startup fails with or without a preset.
